parse.title: Item:Collective Sight
parse.text:
Collective Sight

Minimum level 15
Item Type Jewelry / Goggles
Slot Eye
Race Absolutely Required None
Binding Bound to Account on Acquire
Durability 250
Material SteelSteel: Steel is the common metal used to make weapons and armor.
Hardness 35
Base Value 00060200006,020ppPlatinum Piece 
Weight 0.10 lbs
Location Blown Deadline, End Chest
Enchantments
  • Nearly FinishedNearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.
    • One of the following:
      • Charisma +8 Charisma +8: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
      • Constitution +8 Constitution +8: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
      • Dexterity +8 Dexterity +8: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
      • Intelligence +8 Intelligence +8: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
      • Strength +8 Strength +8: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
      • Wisdom +8 Wisdom +8: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
  • Almost There
    • One of the following:
      • Insightful Charisma +3Insightful Charisma +3: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Charisma.
      • Insightful Constitution +3Insightful Constitution +3: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Constitution.
      • Insightful Dexterity +3Insightful Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
      • Insightful Intelligence +3Insightful Intelligence +3: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
      • Insightful Strength +3Insightful Strength +3: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Strength.
      • Insightful Wisdom +3Insightful Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Wisdom.
  • Quality Resistance +1Quality Resistance +1: Passive: +1 Quality bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
  • Temperance of BeliefTemperance of Belief: You have a +1 quality bonus to Magical Resistance Rating per Religious Lore feat.
  • Blue Augment SlotBlue and Colorless
  • Mythic Goggle Boost +1 or +3Mythic Goggle Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.
    (This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
Upgradeable? Nearly Finished
Description You Make The Item: 2019! Designed by the Dungeons and Dragons: Online Community.
Tips

This item is a result of a series of polls on official DDO forums:

  • Community: You Make The Item! ARCHIVE ME!
  • You Make The Item! (WEEK 2) ARCHIVE ME!
  • You Make The Item! (WEEK 3) ARCHIVE ME!
  • You Make The Item! (WEEK 4) ARCHIVE ME!
